long_biography.plain_text:
Born Monique Louis-Dreyfus in 1940, Roosmale Nepveu studied English and Spanish at the Sorbonne. She joined the board of the Louis Dreyfus family holding company, following the agricultural-commodities group for almost thirty years and chairing the holding company's audit committee for six years.

Her inherited minority interest in Louis Dreyfus Holdings established the core of her wealth. After the family buyout concluded in 2019, she shifted from commodity-company shareholder to family-office principal. She now chairs Céleste Management in Geneva and serves on the board of Guisando, using those structures for portfolio management and selected private investments.
